semiconductor_relevance: High — the company manufactures precision motors and encoders specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
summary: Microtech Laboratory specializes in the production of compact rotary encoders and gearless AC servo motors that are optimized for semiconductor manufacturing processes. Their products enhance the performance of equipment used in both front-end and back-end semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Direct drive motors with high torque and compact design
Integration of hollow shaft wiring and air tubes for space-saving
Precision rotation solutions for wafer inspection
